detail.longDescription: whilst reflecting on the early works of somerset maugham, i made a sidequest to #waf. sure there's a lot of options out there from managed providers like #cloudflare #aws #azure #hetzner but why would i want to use that if i'm hosting my own metal and gateways? (the answer is i don't). plus as i continued reading i started thinking about many of these tools like #crowdsec that you can kind of #selfhost but not really. there's so many interesting solutions to #security but many strive for broadstroke approaches and fit more for #enterprise or hyperscale #infrastructure. i don't have the time nor money for all of that. so 11shots of #cofe and i decided to build my own system. it's called sor not sure what the acronym means yet, but sounded lit 🔥 this was built for my own #homelab that runs #kubernetes. edge ingress gateways handle traffic routing as is my established pattern but there's a waf piece that intercepts requests in realtime to make decisions on where they should gain access or if i should re-route them to mossad for the lulz, or serve them up http codes with meatspin ascii. either way, dashboard piece just got to a steadystate and i get to see live probes scan and attack my endpoints. pew pew pew . currently there's base set of rules and known bad patterns blocking skids, but eventually i'm hotwiring #agentic into it so i can go take a nap. tldr: i built my own mini-cloudflare waf setup. you can too. we live in an age where if you stop drinking those becky pumpkin spice lattes and shift your credit card to an #ai #llm provider you'll get enough electro-chink to become a legend (in your own mind ofc). now back to your regularly scheduled white gurl cofe shrine.
